title: Export choices
decision: One workbook of five sheets for the whole shop, written without a new dependency; one export at a time and five a day per shop; the file is kept seven days; managers and owners may export, in a suspended shop only the owner; the file holds customers' names and phones and no Telegram identifier; stored_file.purpose gained the value export; the file store's object limit was raised to 256 MB
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 52
rationale: REQ-028 asks for an export and the specification for .xlsx; neither gives limits or retention
